venues.name: California Academy of Sciences
venues.why: Aquarium, rainforest dome, and planetarium under one roof — fully indoor with changing tables.

hl.stroller: Ramps and elevators throughout; easy with a stroller.
hl.indoor: Everything indoors — perfect for a foggy SF afternoon.

venues.name: Exploratorium
venues.why: Hundreds of hands-on exhibits right on the bay — endlessly engaging for curious kids.

hl.indoor: A huge indoor playground for the mind on the waterfront.

venues.name: Golden Gate Park
venues.why: Bigger than Central Park, with gardens, a carousel, and the Koret playground — calm and free.

hl.stroller: Flat, shaded paths between the gardens.
hl.naptimed: Quiet meadows make an easy stroller nap.
hl.free: Free to roam — pick a corner and linger.

venues.name: San Francisco Zoo
venues.why: An oceanside zoo with a little steam train and a hands-on children's zoo.

hl.stroller: Flat, paved loops — easy going with little ones.

venues.name: Pier 39
venues.why: Barking sea lions, a double-decker carousel, and bay views — free to wander.

hl.naptimed: The mellow waterfront stroll lulls kids right off.
hl.free: Free to walk the pier and watch the sea lions.

venues.name: Crissy Field
venues.why: Flat shoreline paths and a calm beach under the Golden Gate Bridge — wide open and free.

hl.naptimed: The long, flat shoreline path is a dependable nap walk.
hl.free: Free beach and bridge views — bring a picnic.

venues.name: Aquarium of the Bay
venues.why: Walk-through tunnels of local bay sea life — compact, indoor, and right on Pier 39.

hl.stroller: Step-free tunnels; easy with a stroller.
hl.indoor: A quick indoor option by the wharf.

venues.name: Children's Creativity Museum
venues.why: Hands-on art and tech studios plus the historic carousel next door at Yerba Buena.

hl.stroller: Open, step-free studios with stroller parking.
hl.indoor: All-indoor making and tinkering — a good rainy backup.

venues.name: Mel's Drive-In
venues.why: A retro diner with a kids' menu, high chairs, and milkshakes — easy crowd-pleaser.

hl.kidmenu: Classic kids' plates and shakes; high chairs ready.
hl.indoor: Comfy booths for a midday break.

venues.name: Tony's Pizza Napoletana
venues.why: Famous pizza in North Beach with simple cheese pies the kids will devour.

hl.kidmenu: Plain cheese pizza and high chairs keep everyone happy.
hl.indoor: A warm indoor sit-down between sights.

venues.name: Ghirardelli Square
venues.why: A hot-fudge sundae stop in a historic square — a sweet, low-key midday treat.

hl.kidmenu: Sundaes and simple bites the whole family shares.
hl.indoor: Duck inside the chocolate shop out of the wind.

hotels.name: Argonaut Hotel
hotels.why: A playful nautical hotel right on the wharf — walk to the sea lions, the cable car, and Ghirardelli Square.

hotels.name: Hyatt Regency San Francisco
hotels.why: Big rooms and a dramatic atrium right by the Embarcadero and the historic F-line streetcar to the wharf.

hotels.name: Hotel Zephyr Fisherman's Wharf
hotels.why: A fun waterfront hotel with an outdoor games courtyard the kids love, steps from Pier 39.
hotels.note: Heads up: a daily amenity fee applies.

hotels.name: Hilton San Francisco Union Square
hotels.why: A central base by Union Square with a pool and the Powell St cable car a block away.
